content.short: Tonano is a protocol for TON inscriptions, allowing for unique on-chain data storage and asset minting.
content.description: Tonano is a specialized protocol designed to bring the concept of inscriptions (similar to Bitcoin Ordinals) to the TON blockchain. It allows users to 'inscribe' unique data, such as images, text, or tokens, directly onto the TON blockchain in a permanent and immutable way. Tonano provides a platform for minting and trading these on-chain assets, opening up new possibilities for digital art, decentralized storage, and unique token standards on TON. By leveraging the network's low fees and high scalability, Tonano is at the forefront of the inscriptions movement on TON.
content.meta: Explore TON inscriptions with Tonano. Mint and trade on-chain assets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
